PRODUCT DESIGN CASE STUDY

Kremor AI

MY ROLE · End-to-end product design and AI model evaluation

Kremor AI

I designed Kremor AI from the creative workspace through the storefront and workshop operations. I wanted an idea for a garment to have a clear path to the people who could actually make it.

01What I wanted to solve

A generated image is not a finished garment. I worked on prompting and iteration alongside measurements, approvals, artisan roles and production. Separately, my model-evaluation work covered 96+ complex AI interaction tasks.

02The decisions that mattered

Give people a useful first move.

I used quick actions and conversational openers for people who know the occasion or fabric but not how to write a design prompt.

Respect the textile language.

I named Ankara, Aso-Oke, Adire and Kente rather than treating African fashion as one generic style.

Make the workshop accountable.

I designed role-based permissions, confirmations for dangerous actions and a read-only audit history.
